citations.supports: Mobile applications load the Rust library mobile entry point through platform frameworks.
A complete app plus Tauri CLI is required before Android/iOS target initialization and execution.
Android and iOS require their Rust targets and platform toolchains.
Real mobile execution crosses Rust PluginHandle into Kotlin Command or Swift Invoke code.
Capabilities bind permissions to windows and matching capability permissions merge.
Plugin commands are unavailable to frontend code until a capability grants their permission.
The current base app template defines staticlib/cdylib/rlib and mobile_entry_point.
The accepted local contract requires exact platform response, denial, visual, environment, and hash receipts.
graph_platform_ping calls EntityGraphExt::ping, which uses run_mobile_plugin on mobile.
